title: cmd_and_ctrl / Engine and bots
description: Actions by type and seat kind, rejections and apply time, effect errors, restore points, and the bot and model seats (ADR 0123 §9).

list.name: env
list.label: env
list.description: Which environment's host and server to show.

panels.title: Applied actions per minute, by type
panels.description: Commits through a room that applied, by action type (bundle: several mutations committed together; lobby: a setup commit such as a join or the start).

panels.title: Actions per minute, by seat kind
panels.description: Who made the commits: human, bot, agent (an MCP seat) or admin.

panels.title: Rejected actions per minute, by type
panels.description: Commits the engine refused and rolled back. A client offering moves the engine refuses shows up here.

panels.title: Share of actions rejected
panels.description: Rejected commits over all commits.

panels.title: Apply time
panels.description: Time a commit held the room lock: dispatch, state capture and the restore-point write. 50th and 99th percentile.

panels.title: Effect errors
panels.description: A card's effect failed mid-resolution and the engine carried on. Not an alert: a reason to look at the Logs dashboard.

panels.title: Restore-point age
panels.description: The oldest restore point among active rooms that have moved past theirs: how much a deploy now would rewind. RestorePointLagging fires above 10 minutes.

panels.title: Rooms behind their restore point
panels.description: Active rooms whose last applied commit is not captured yet.

panels.title: Last boot: restored
panels.description: Restore points the last boot brought back as live tables.

panels.title: Last boot: already ended
panels.description: Restore points the last boot found were for games that had ended.

panels.title: Last boot: abandoned
panels.description: Restore points the last boot could not restore. Their players lost the game. RestoreAbandonedGames fires on this.

panels.title: Last boot: degraded cards
panels.description: Cards the last boot flagged as having lost catalog abilities on restore. They play as manual for the rest of their game.

panels.title: Bot decisions per minute, by layer
panels.description: Which layer answered: A the rules filter, B the heuristic, C the model, or random (the random tier, which has no layers).

panels.title: Bot decisions per minute, by tier
panels.description: random, heuristic, assisted, strong (other: a test or harness policy).

panels.title: Bot decision time, 95th percentile, by tier
panels.description: Time a bot policy took to decide one window, deadline misses included.

panels.title: Fallbacks per minute, by cause
panels.description: Windows whose answer fell back. The runner's causes (timeout, policy-error, out-of-range, decline-pass, decline-always-legal) and the model funnel's, prefixed model-.

panels.title: Fallbacks per minute, by tier
panels.description: The same fallbacks, by the tier of the seat that fell back.

panels.title: Model calls per minute, by result
panels.description: Decision calls a model-backed seat made: ok, timeout, error, malformed, out_of_range.

panels.title: Model timeout rate
panels.description: Share of model calls that ran out of time. Not an alert: a slow model makes a model seat play like the heuristic.

panels.title: Model call time, by tier
panels.description: 50th and 95th percentile time inside one decision call to a model.

panels.title: Model tokens per minute
panels.description: Tokens the model calls reported, decisions and improvisations together: prompt (input plus cache reads and writes) and completion.

panels.title: Model tokens in range
panels.description: Tokens the model calls reported over the dashboard's time range.
